messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: high GPU pressure detected in dedicated pool aurion-prod-pool (us-west2). GPUs at 95%+, queue depth rising quickly — paging on-call.

leo-oncall: got the page, joining Zoom now (zoom.us/j/000000000). Will triage.

sam.sre: looking at grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/aurion/prod/pool: sustained 98% utilization, enqueue latency spiking. A bunch of long-running generative jobs started ~06:12 UTC. Two pods showing OOM and GPU memory errors.

maya-eng: @sam can you dump the top pods? IIRC autoscale was disabled for this pool per the Aurion contract.

sam.sre: pod snapshot and status:
```
NAMESPACE    NAME                      READY  STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
aurion-prod  aurion-gen-batch-0        0/1    CrashLoopBackOff   3          52m
aurion-prod  aurion-generator-1        1/1    Running            0          3h
aurion-prod  aurion-ingest-ml-2        1/1    Running            0          2h
```
Autoscale: disabled in pool config. Burst: disabled.

sam.sre: immediate options: enable manual burst to shared capacity (needs ops-lead approval), or isolate/cordon nodes to push batch to pending -> slows work, or ask customer to kill the batch.

amanda-cs: FYI @leo I just called the Aurion on-call. They say an overnight data reingestion kicked off accidentally and they're terminating it. Asking for a kill signal now.

leo-oncall: I'll apply a temporary taint to keep new jobs off the saturated nodes and open a short ingress rate limit. Executing taint in 30s.

sam.sre: applying taint: `kubectl taint nodes nvidia-a1 dedicatedTempNoSchedule=true:NoSchedule` — patched. Batch pods are Pending now, queue depth dropping from 320 -> 40.

incident-bot: ACTION: manual burst request created (burst-request-id: BR-20260317-1769876543). Approver: ops-lead.

ops-lead: I see the request, approving 30m burst to shared-capacity with cost hold. Please document estimated cost and notify billing.

sam.sre: enabling burst -> provisioning 6 GPUs from shared pool. Allocated. Latency trending back to baseline within 90s.

amanda-cs: Aurion confirms they canceled the reingestion job and are running a root-cause assessment. They're fine with the burst but want a breakdown for their team and cost.

leo-oncall: logging incident ticket INC-1769876543 and starting handoff notes to infra-runbooks. I'll remain on-call for 30m to verify stability. :thumbsup:

sam.sre: added cost estimate to ticket: ~ $2.3k for the 30m burst (approx). Also attached grafana panels and pod logs.

ops-lead: good. Please add a short follow-up: propose a policy change — allow pre-approved emergency burst for enterprise customers with notification-only billing alerts.

sam.sre: noted. I'll create a PR to update the runbook and include the suggested pre-approval flow.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: GPU pressure reduced, queue drained, burst ended. Reminder: runbook `enterprise-dedicated-burst` recommends pre-approved burst windows and contact routing for customers running large batches.

leo-oncall: handoff complete. Leaving the incident open for post-mortem artifacts. On-call clear in 30m unless new alerts.
